environment.scope: Repository-only corrective implementation (ADR-0113). Closes the two pkt-147 live-demo blockers: (1) the standing immediate emitter had no ingest signing key so the <=1s path could not operate; (2) provision_authorized_live_copier_bridge enables the OPEN flag stack but NOT the per-op LIVE MODIFY/FULL_CLOSE execution flags, so a copied OPEN could strand a real position on the live follower. Delivers: a single fail-closed arming contract (lifecycle_arm_contract) enforcing MODIFY+FULL_CLOSE authority AND execution-flag coherence with the no-OPEN-without-executable-CLOSE invariant and partial-close exclusion; one atomic arm_copier_live_lifecycle operation (validate-all -> provision admission -> enable emitter -> create arm, full rollback to DARK on any failure; host effects injected); an idempotent teardown_copier_live_dark; a value-blind emitter-key readiness contract (run_emitter.py auto-loads a protected standing key file; reviewed account-46-pinned Provision-GuvfxCopierEmitterKey.ps1 provisioner with value-blind -Verify, idempotent -Remove, tenant READ-ONLY ACL, #48/CZ/arbitrary refusal); and a hardened copier_live_demo_preflight arm_readiness section. NO production/host/flag/key/admission/task/#48/broker mutation.

expected_results: The authority contract refuses an authorization missing MODIFY or FULL_CLOSE authority (OPEN_WITHOUT_CLOSE_REFUSED), any partial-close authority, volume>0.01, max_orders!=1, or a wrong route/symbol.

The flag contract (ARM time) refuses unless OPEN+MODIFY+FULL_CLOSE execution flags + mutation dispatch/transport all agree with the authorities; OPEN executable while FULL_CLOSE is not is refused; a flag without its authority is LIFECYCLE_AUTHORITY_FLAG_MISMATCH; partial-close flag on is refused.

arm_copier_live_lifecycle validates the complete contract before any mutation; on admission/emitter/arm failure it rolls the entire stack back to DARK and creates no arm; missing emitter-key readiness, unconfirmed #48 flatness, host admission not OFF, or emitter task not disabled all refuse fail-closed.

teardown_copier_live_dark is idempotent and returns backend DARK after success/partial/abort; host steps without a signed actuator are reported UNPROVEN, never done; --no-revoke preserves the authorization for rollback.
copier_live_demo_preflight emits a fail-closed arm_readiness section + arm_ready boolean with the new blocker codes, WITHOUT changing the legacy blockers list consumed by copier_live_arm.

The standing emitter-key provisioner provisions on the fixed account-46 path only, refuses #48/Customer Zero/arbitrary accounts, grants the tenant READ-ONLY, writes atomically with a value-blind -Verify, is idempotent on -Remove, never prints the key, and run_emitter.py auto-loads the protected key file process-local.
